verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is an API-first product. Its documented public API is OpenAI-compatible and supports streaming, structured outputs, tool calling, batch processing and a dedicated-endpoint management API. Official Python and Node SDKs cover it, it serves agent-readable llms.txt and markdown docs, and community users report driving it via API keys (llm-cerebras plugin, voice assistant). Missing for 10: no published OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths (probe returned 404), and a community report cites a 422 format error with one third-party router integration.
